title: An acidic digestive compartment
hook: Locate one step on the digestive map.

knows: Digestion involves several organs and routes.
doesNotKnow: Parietal cells in gastric glands secrete hydrochloric acid into the stomach. The stomach also has protective mechanisms for its lining.

misconception: All digestive processes happen in a single organ.
objective: Locate the stated digestive process or absorption route.

claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: In which organ do parietal cells secrete hydrochloric acid into digestive contents? Parietal cells in gastric glands secrete hydrochloric acid into the stomach. The stomach also has protective mechanisms for its lining.
The map shows selected connections schematically; it is not an anatomical scale drawing or a complete account of digestion.
